# Inference Recommendation Engine (IRE)

> Daily ranked model picks for people and agents using their own InferHub key. A static, versioned JSON feed names the exact route, the lowest listed price per 1M tokens, health, gate reasons and licence for a cheap tier and a strongest-open-weight tier. Open-weight models only. No key is ever in the feed; bring your own INFERHUB_API_KEY.

Feed contract: schema_version "ire-feed/v2"; refreshed once a day at 11:10 UTC by a GitHub Action; respect stale_after. Pick the first entry with recommended == true in tiers.cheap or tiers.strongest_open and send its best_route as the model name to https://api.inferhub.dev/v1 (OpenAI-compatible, Bearer key) or https://api.inferhub.dev (Anthropic-compatible, x-api-key). Every entry has open_weight: true and a licence object (name, url, weights_url).

## Feed

- [today.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v2/today.json): today's picks
- [schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v2/schema.json): JSON Schema for the feed
- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pukujan/inference-recommendation-engine/data/ire-feed/feed/v2/index.json): list of daily files under feed/v2/days/
